# TMI Translation Bundle (tmi/translation-bundle)

> Make any Doctrine entity translatable by adding a single trait and interface. Translations are stored in the same table as the source entity, eliminating expensive joins and delivering the same query performance as non-translated entities. Built for Symfony developers building multilingual applications.

## Getting Started

- [README](https://github.com/CreativeNative/translation-bundle/blob/master/README.md): Installation, configuration, and quick start guide
- [Developer & AI Guide](https://github.com/CreativeNative/translation-bundle/blob/master/llms.md): Comprehensive glossary, handler chain decision tree, troubleshooting guide, and minimal working example
- [Upgrade Guide](https://github.com/CreativeNative/translation-bundle/blob/master/UPGRADING.md): Migration guide covering every major version from v1.x through v4.0, with before/after code examples and per-platform schema migration snippets

## Core Interfaces

- [TranslatableInterface](https://github.com/CreativeNative/translation-bundle/blob/master/src/Doctrine/Model/TranslatableInterface.php): Entity translation contract that entities must implement
- [TranslatableTrait](https://github.com/CreativeNative/translation-bundle/blob/master/src/Doctrine/Model/TranslatableTrait.php): Default implementation providing locale and tuuid management
- [EntityTranslatorInterface](https://github.com/CreativeNative/translation-bundle/blob/master/src/Translation/EntityTranslatorInterface.php): Translation orchestrator service contract
- [TranslationHandlerInterface](https://github.com/CreativeNative/translation-bundle/blob/master/src/Translation/Handlers/TranslationHandlerInterface.php): Handler chain protocol for field translation
- [TmiTranslationExtension (Twig)](https://github.com/CreativeNative/translation-bundle/blob/master/src/Twig/TmiTranslationExtension.php): Registers the `translatable` Twig test and the `tmi_locales` global (renamed from `locales` in v4.0)

## Attributes

- [SharedAmongstTranslations](https://github.com/CreativeNative/translation-bundle/blob/master/src/Doctrine/Attribute/SharedAmongstTranslations.php): Mark fields whose value is copied from the source when a translation is created (copy-on-translate; reconcile later edits via tmi:translation:sync-shared)
- [EmptyOnTranslate](https://github.com/CreativeNative/translation-bundle/blob/master/src/Doctrine/Attribute/EmptyOnTranslate.php): Mark fields to be cleared when creating new translations

## Handler Reference

- [PrimaryKeyHandler](https://github.com/CreativeNative/translation-bundle/blob/master/src/Translation/Handlers/PrimaryKeyHandler.php): Handles ID field generation for new translations
- [ScalarHandler](https://github.com/CreativeNative/translation-bundle/blob/master/src/Translation/Handlers/ScalarHandler.php): Handles primitive types (string, int, float, bool)
- [TranslatableEntityHandler](https://github.com/CreativeNative/translation-bundle/blob/master/src/Translation/Handlers/TranslatableEntityHandler.php): Handles nested translatable entities
- [DoctrineObjectHandler](https://github.com/CreativeNative/translation-bundle/blob/master/src/Translation/Handlers/DoctrineObjectHandler.php): Handles non-translatable Doctrine entity references
- [EmbeddedHandler](https://github.com/CreativeNative/translation-bundle/blob/master/src/Translation/Handlers/EmbeddedHandler.php): Handles Doctrine embeddables
- [BidirectionalManyToOneHandler](https://github.com/CreativeNative/translation-bundle/blob/master/src/Translation/Handlers/BidirectionalManyToOneHandler.php): ManyToOne with `inversedBy`
- [BidirectionalOneToManyHandler](https://github.com/CreativeNative/translation-bundle/blob/master/src/Translation/Handlers/BidirectionalOneToManyHandler.php): OneToMany with `mappedBy` — translates the children collection
- [BidirectionalOneToOneHandler](https://github.com/CreativeNative/translation-bundle/blob/master/src/Translation/Handlers/BidirectionalOneToOneHandler.php): OneToOne with `mappedBy` or `inversedBy`, either direction
- [BidirectionalManyToManyHandler](https://github.com/CreativeNative/translation-bundle/blob/master/src/Translation/Handlers/BidirectionalManyToManyHandler.php): ManyToMany with `mappedBy` or `inversedBy`, either direction
- [UnidirectionalManyToManyHandler](https://github.com/CreativeNative/translation-bundle/blob/master/src/Translation/Handlers/UnidirectionalManyToManyHandler.php): ManyToMany without `mappedBy`/`inversedBy`
- [Handler Priority Guide](https://github.com/CreativeNative/translation-bundle/blob/master/.agents/skills/custom-handler-creator/references/handler-priority.md): Priority decision matrix for handler ordering

Custom handlers are tagged `tmi_translation.translation_handler`; the tag's `priority` decides where they sit in the first-match-wins chain.

## Value Objects

- [Tuuid](https://github.com/CreativeNative/translation-bundle/blob/master/src/ValueObject/Tuuid.php): Translation UUID linking related translations
- [TuuidType](https://github.com/CreativeNative/translation-bundle/blob/master/src/Doctrine/Type/TuuidType.php): Doctrine DBAL type for Tuuid persistence

## Events and Filters

- [TranslateEvent](https://github.com/CreativeNative/translation-bundle/blob/master/src/Event/TranslateEvent.php): Shared base class for the two events below; never dispatched directly
- [PreTranslateEvent](https://github.com/CreativeNative/translation-bundle/blob/master/src/Event/PreTranslateEvent.php): Dispatched before a handler builds the new variant — subscribe with `PreTranslateEvent::class`, not a string event name (v4.0)
- [PostTranslateEvent](https://github.com/CreativeNative/translation-bundle/blob/master/src/Event/PostTranslateEvent.php): Dispatched after the new variant is constructed and before it is persisted — the supported seeding hook; subscribe with `PostTranslateEvent::class` (v4.0)
- [LocaleFilter](https://github.com/CreativeNative/translation-bundle/blob/master/src/Doctrine/Filter/LocaleFilter.php): Automatic query filtering by current locale; `LocaleFilter::NAME` is the single source of truth for the filter name

## v2.0 Services

- [TranslationCacheInterface](https://github.com/CreativeNative/translation-bundle/blob/master/src/Translation/Cache/TranslationCacheInterface.php): Translation cache abstraction for custom implementations (Redis, PSR-6, etc.)
- [Translatable](https://github.com/CreativeNative/translation-bundle/blob/master/src/Doctrine/Attribute/Translatable.php): Entity-level attribute for per-entity copy_source control
- [TypeDefaultResolver](https://github.com/CreativeNative/translation-bundle/blob/master/src/Translation/TypeDefaultResolver.php): Type-safe default value resolution for EmptyOnTranslate

## v2.1 Locale Variant DX

- [TranslatableRepositoryTrait](https://github.com/CreativeNative/translation-bundle/blob/master/src/Doctrine/Repository/TranslatableRepositoryTrait.php): Repository trait providing `findAllLocaleVariants()` and `findAllLocaleVariantsBatch()` for batch locale variant queries
- EntityTranslatorInterface: New methods `translateAndPersist()` (translate + persist in one call) and `getOrTranslate()` (find existing or create + persist)
- TranslatableEntityHandler: Auto-resets generated IDs (`#[ORM\Id]` + `#[ORM\GeneratedValue]`) on cloned translations

## v3.1 Per-Locale Completeness

- [LocaleCompletenessResolver](https://github.com/CreativeNative/translation-bundle/blob/master/src/Translation/LocaleCompletenessResolver.php): Per-locale translation status for a Tuuid group — `resolve()`, `resolveForEntity()`, `resolveBatch()` (one query for many Tuuids)
- [LocaleCompleteness](https://github.com/CreativeNative/translation-bundle/blob/master/src/ValueObject/LocaleCompleteness.php): Value object answering per enabled locale: variant exists? content complete relative to the baseline variant?
- [TranslationStatus](https://github.com/CreativeNative/translation-bundle/blob/master/src/ValueObject/TranslationStatus.php): Enum `Missing` | `Incomplete` | `Complete`

## v2.2 Tuuid Linkage Integrity

- [TranslatableEntityRepository](https://github.com/CreativeNative/translation-bundle/blob/master/src/Doctrine/Repository/TranslatableEntityRepository.php): Ready-made repository base class — extend it instead of hand-rolling locale-variant lookups
- [TranslatableIndexListener](https://github.com/CreativeNative/translation-bundle/blob/master/src/Doctrine/EventListener/TranslatableIndexListener.php): Injects a composite `(tuuid, locale)` index into every translatable entity; `unique_locale_variants: true` promotes it to a UNIQUE constraint
- [OrphanTranslationException](https://github.com/CreativeNative/translation-bundle/blob/master/src/Exception/OrphanTranslationException.php): Thrown (when `strict_orphan_check` is on) for entities flushed in a non-default locale without a shared Tuuid
- `tmi:translation:doctor`: Console command — scans for standalone/incomplete/duplicate translations and, as of v4.0, `null-tuuid` rows (a literal database NULL, only reachable via a write outside the entity layer); `--entity=<FQCN>` restricts the scan to one entity (v4.0); exits non-zero for CI gating
- `tmi:translation:sync-shared`: Console command — back-fills `#[SharedAmongstTranslations]` column values across existing locale variants (`--dry-run`, `--check` for CI drift gates, `--entity` options); as of v4.0, every run prints a table naming each drifted property, how many Tuuid groups and rows it touched, and whether it was writable

## v3.0 Symfony 8 & Translation Correctness

- Requires Symfony `^8.0` and PHP `>=8.4`; the `^7.3` branch is dropped
- To-many properties (`OneToMany`, `ManyToMany`) are now actually translated — all three collection handlers were unreachable before, so a translation silently shared the source entity's collection instance
- Translating an entity into the locale it already carries is the identity operation: the same instance comes back, nothing is cloned or cached
- Translating into a different locale is get-or-create, not a live sync: an existing variant for that Tuuid + locale is returned as-is, so in-memory edits made to the source after the variant was created are not propagated into it — use `#[SharedAmongstTranslations]` + `tmi:translation:sync-shared` to propagate such changes
- `#[SharedAmongstTranslations]` on an association collection throws instead of being silently ignored
- Handler tag `priority` is honoured by the compiler pass; equal priorities keep registration order
- `LocaleFilterConfigurator` restores the parent request's locale on `kernel.finish_request` after sub-requests
- The in-progress cycle-detection flag is always cleared, even when a handler throws; `Psr6TranslationCache` gives it a 60s TTL
- `TypeDefaultResolver` throws for every non-nullable type without a zero-value (adds `iterable`, `object`, intersection types); `null` is only returned for types that accept it
- `tmi:translation:sync-shared` detects embeddable-level sharing and reports readonly drift with a non-zero exit

## v4.0 Removal Semantics, Filter-Safe Lookups & Performance

- [LocaleVariantFinder](https://github.com/CreativeNative/translation-bundle/blob/master/src/Doctrine/LocaleVariantFinder.php): The one place that queries across every locale variant of a Tuuid, suspending `LocaleFilter` for the query and restoring it afterwards — `findAllLocaleVariants[Batch]()`, `findLocaleVariant()`, `findLocaleVariantsBatch()`, `withoutLocaleFilter()`; `TranslatableRepositoryTrait` and `LocaleCompletenessResolver` delegate to it
- [TranslatableRemover](https://github.com/CreativeNative/translation-bundle/blob/master/src/Doctrine/TranslatableRemover.php): `removeAllLocaleVariants()` removes every locale variant sharing a Tuuid, `removeSingleLocaleVariant()` removes exactly one and exempts it from the opt-in cascade below — always via `EntityManager::remove()` per variant, never a bulk DQL DELETE, so ORM cascades/`orphanRemoval`/lifecycle callbacks fire correctly
- [LocaleVariantRemovalListener](https://github.com/CreativeNative/translation-bundle/blob/master/src/Doctrine/EventListener/LocaleVariantRemovalListener.php): Opt-in `preRemove` listener — gated on `cascade_remove_locale_variants` — that makes a plain `$em->remove($entity)` cascade to sibling locale variants via `TranslatableRemover::cascadeFromPreRemove()`
- `EntityTranslatorInterface::preload(iterable $entities, string $locale): void`: Batch-loads each entity's `$locale` variant ahead of time, one query per class instead of one per entity — additive interface method, call once before looping `getOrTranslate()` over an import batch
- Cross-locale lookups (`preload()`'s internal warmup) now go through `LocaleVariantFinder` — under an active `LocaleFilter`, they used to mint a duplicate row on every `translate()` call instead of reusing the existing one
- `TranslatableEntityHandler` no longer checks for an existing target-locale variant itself (redundant with `preload()`'s own check, which `EntityTranslator::processTranslation()` always runs first — see [UPGRADING.md § 7](https://github.com/CreativeNative/translation-bundle/blob/master/UPGRADING.md#7-translatableentityhandler-no-longer-checks-for-an-existing-variant-itself)); `EntityTranslator` remembers a `preload()` batch's misses so a per-entity `getOrTranslate()` import loop after it costs no further lookup queries, and is `kernel.reset`-tagged to forget that memory between units of work
- `BidirectionalOneToManyHandler`, `BidirectionalManyToManyHandler` and `UnidirectionalManyToManyHandler` each call `preload()` with their whole collection once before looping — a parent with *K* already-translated association children of one class costs 2 queries total (the parent's own miss + one batched children lookup), not `1 + K`; call `preload()` yourself only for a batch of top-level entities
- The translation cache is identity-safe across `EntityManager::clear()` — a detached cache hit is treated as a miss instead of being re-inserted as a duplicate row by `persist()`; `InMemoryTranslationCache` implements `ResetInterface` (tagged `kernel.reset`) for long-running workers
- `Psr6TranslationCache` is removed (v4.0) — `TranslationCacheInterface` aliases only to `InMemoryTranslationCache` now; the interface itself is unchanged and still open to custom implementations
- `TranslatableEntityLocator` names only each inheritance hierarchy's root (not every subclass); `doctor`/`sync-shared`/`TranslatableEntityValidationWarmer` resolve each hydrated row's own concrete class for its property list, so a subclass-only field is still seen and a hierarchy's rows are counted once
- The direct `ManyToOne`/`OneToOne` form (a field on the *owning* class, not a back-reference) now translates its target entity (get-or-create) instead of silently returning the untranslated source
- `strict_discovery` (config, default `false`): turns a `0 translatable entities discovered` compile-time result from a logged warning into a `LogicException`; `AttributeValidationPass` also publishes `tmi_translation.discovered_translatable_classes` (sorted `list<class-string>`) as a container parameter
- `cascade_remove_locale_variants` (config, default `false`): see `LocaleVariantRemovalListener` above
- The `tuuid` DBAL type self-registers via `prepend()` — no manual `doctrine.dbal.types` entry needed; `TuuidType::convertToPHPValue(null)` now returns `null` instead of inventing a fresh Tuuid; the `tuuid`/`locale` columns are `NOT NULL` (`locale` grows to length 16); the dead `translations` JSON column and its four trait accessors are removed
- The four `EntityTranslator` lifecycle hooks (`afterLoad`/`beforePersist`/`beforeUpdate`/`beforeRemove`) are removed — every call was the identity operation, always; every bundle service is now private (autowire by interface/class); the Twig global `locales` is renamed `tmi_locales`
- `TranslationHandlerInterface` narrows from four methods to two — `supports(TranslationContext)`/`translate(TranslationContext)` — on the typed `EntityTranslationContext`/`PropertyTranslationContext` contract, replacing the four-method `TranslationArgs` DTO; `isShared()`/`isEmpty()` on the context (pre-resolved by `EntityTranslator` before dispatch) replace the two removed interface methods (see [UPGRADING.md § 6](https://github.com/CreativeNative/translation-bundle/blob/master/UPGRADING.md#6-translationhandlerinterface-is-two-methods-on-typed-contexts))
- `AttributeHelper` and `ReflectionHelper::getHierarchyProperties()` memoize per (proxy-unwrapped) class — the `translate()` hot path no longer re-walks a class's attributes/property hierarchy on every property, every call
- [Performance](https://github.com/CreativeNative/translation-bundle/blob/master/README.md#-performance): every query-cost number the README states is enforced by an exact assertion in [`tests/Performance/QueryBudgetTest.php`](https://github.com/CreativeNative/translation-bundle/blob/master/tests/Performance/QueryBudgetTest.php) — e.g. `find()` under the active locale filter = 1 query, `translate()` into an existing variant = 1 query and 0 inserts
- Coverage: 100% **line** coverage is a CI gate (`composer test`, tracked by the Codecov badge), not a one-time snapshot; PHPStan runs at level max with the strict-rules/doctrine/symfony/phpunit extensions; PHPUnit runs in strict mode (`failOnWarning`/`failOnNotice`/`failOnRisky`/`failOnDeprecation`)
